app.name: 10CYBER Exposure
app.tagline: See which devices are exposed to each vulnerability, and fix the riskiest first.

widget.description: Leading Tailwind CSS Admin Template with 500+ UI Component and Pages.

complete.title: Data is complete
complete.body: Every finding was read from CrowdStrike Falcon. Last complete update: {time}.

partial.title: Data is incomplete
partial.body: Some findings could not be read, so the numbers may be lower than the real figures. Last complete update: {time}.

failed.title: Could not read data from Falcon
failed.body: The last sync failed, so no data is available. Ask your TENIX SOC to check the Falcon connection.

not_synced.title: No data yet
not_synced.body: Data has not been synced from Falcon yet. It appears after the first sync.

no_cids.title: No Falcon account is linked
no_cids.body: This organization has no Falcon customer ID (CID) yet. Ask your TENIX SOC administrator to link one.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Open vulnerabilities and affected devices from CrowdStrike Falcon.

metrics.exploitedNote: Known to be used in attacks

severity.title: Findings by severity
severity.description: Open findings at each severity level.

trend.description: Last {count} days, one point per day.
trend.oneDay: Only one day of history so far. The chart fills in with each daily update.
trend.empty: No history yet. It appears after the first complete update.

vulns.title: Vulnerabilities
vulns.description: CVEs with open findings in your organization.

empty.filtered: No vulnerabilities match your filters. Clear the search or choose another severity.
empty.none: No open vulnerabilities were found as of the last complete update.
empty.unknown: No vulnerabilities to show. The data is not complete, so this does not mean there are none.

detail.exprtHelp: ExPRT is CrowdStrike's exploit prediction rating.
detail.noRemediation: Falcon returned no recommended action for this CVE.
detail.notFoundComplete: No device in this organization has an open finding for this CVE as of {time}.
detail.notFoundPartial: No finding for this CVE is in the data we have, but the data is incomplete. It may still affect some devices.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Devices with open findings. A device is identified by its CID and device ID, not by its name.
devices.searchPlaceholder: Search name, IP or device ID…

empty.none: No devices with open findings as of the last complete update.
empty.unknown: No devices to show. The data is not complete, so this does not mean there are none.

devices.unnamedHint: Falcon has no host name for this device.

sheet.graphHelp: Device → software → worst vulnerabilities. Click a CVE to open it.
sheet.showing: Showing the {shown} most severe of {total} findings.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Connect CrowdStrike Falcon and decide which Falcon accounts each organization can see.

falcon.title: CrowdStrike Falcon
falcon.description: 10CYBER Exposure reads vulnerability data from Falcon with a read-only API client.
falcon.secretSaved: Saved. Leave empty to keep the current secret.
falcon.secretHelp: Create the API client in Falcon with read-only access to Vulnerabilities (Spotlight) and Hosts. The secret is stored encrypted and is never shown again.

testFail.invalid_credentials: Falcon rejected the client ID or secret. Check them and try again.
testFail.missing_scope: The API client is missing a required read scope. Add it in Falcon and try again.
testFail.unreachable: Could not reach Falcon. Check the cloud URL and the network.
testFail.error: Falcon returned an unexpected error. Try again later.

falcon.invalid_base_url: Use an official CrowdStrike API URL, for example https://api.us-2.crowdstrike.com.

sync.title: Data sync
sync.description: Findings are read from Falcon every hour. Run a sync to refresh now. Large environments take several minutes.
sync.started: Sync started. This can take a few minutes.
sync.noCids: Link at least one CID to an organization first.

organizations.title: Organizations and CIDs
organizations.description: Each organization sees only the Falcon CIDs linked to it. A CID belongs to one organization.
organizations.name: Organization name
organizations.cidsHelp: One CID per line. A CID has 32 hexadecimal characters.
organizations.count: {count, plural, =0 {No CIDs} one {# CID} other {# CIDs}}
organizations.empty: No organizations yet. Add the first one.

errors.cid_taken: One of these CIDs is already linked to another organization.
errors.invalid_cid: Each CID must have 32 hexadecimal characters.
errors.exists: An organization with this name already exists.

senders.title: Senders
senders.description: The mailboxes 10CYBER Exposure sends alert emails from. The first one added is used.
senders.empty: No sender yet. Add one to send alert emails.
senders.name: Name

sender.description: SMTP settings of the mailbox that sends the alerts. The password is stored encrypted and never shown again.
sender.name: Name
sender.keepPassword: Leave empty to keep the current one
sender.invalid: Check the sender details: server, port and from address.

test.title: Send a test email from {name}
test.description: Sends one short message to check that these settings work.
test.sent: Test email sent. Check the inbox.
test.failed: The email could not be sent.

recipients.title: Recipients
recipients.description: Choose who receives which alert. Tick a box to subscribe.
recipients.exists: This recipient already exists for that organization.
recipients.scopeHelp: A recipient tied to an organization only receives alerts about that organization. "All organizations" is for SOC staff.

mfa.title: Two-step verification (MFA)
mfa.description: Optional. Adds a 6-digit code from an authenticator app when you sign in.

mfa.step2: Enter the 6-digit code from the app to finish.
mfa.disableHint: Enter your password and a current code. If you just signed in, wait for the next code.
mfa.invalid: That code is not valid. Enter the newest code from your app.
mfa.disableFailed: The password or code is incorrect. Wait for a new code and try again.

audit.description: Sign-ins, invites and changes. The newest entries come first.
